title: Modeling Agrobacterium -Mediated Gene Transformation of Tobacco ( Nicotiana tabacum )-A Model Plant for Gene Transformation Studies.
summary: Neural networks model Agrobacterium-mediated tobacco transformation outcomes from experimental factors and identify conditions associated with PCR-verified transgenic plants; compared with stepwise regression on experimental data. This is a bounded experimental-process result, not proof that model-guided optimization improved transformation.
ai_technology: MLP neural models predict putative/PCR-verified transformation outcomes from experimental conditions.
